short_description: Qonto is a Paris-based finance platform for small and medium-sized enterprises, freelancers and associations, founded in 2016 by Alexandre Prot and Steve Anavi and operating as a licensed payment institution. It serves Germany through a Berlin branch under the joint supervision of the French ACPR and Germany's BaFin, and entered the German market in earnest by acquiring the Berlin SME neobank Penta in 2022.
